name: Deploy to Production
description: Deploy one already-verified commit to production: load the verified release evidence, stop for its own explicit approval, deploy, independently verify (roll back on failure), and report. Started only on an explicit deploy request; never chained from Development or Deploy to Development.
kickoff:
Start the "Deploy to Production" loop.
Goal: the approved, verified commit runs on production with fresh health evidence.
Max iterations: 1
Exit when: the production deployment was separately approved, deployed, verified (or rolled back) and reported.
Guardrails (do not skip):
- Never deploy without this workflow's own approval
- Never start Deploy to Development from this workflow

loop_contract.name: Deploy to Production
loop_contract.goal: approved verified commit deployed to production with fresh verification evidence
loop_contract.exit_when: production deployment approved in this run, deployed, verified or rolled back, and reported
loop_contract.check_command: configured production health check and smoke journey
guardrails: Do not skip, disable, or bypass the deployment approval gate
Execute only the exact approved commit, target and commands
Never start Deploy to Development from this workflow

expected_check_command: configured production health check and smoke journey pass

steps.name: Load verified release evidence for production
steps.instruction: Read the linked ticket's latest Deploy to Development result packet and completion manifest, the current repository state, and the maintained deployment configuration for the production environment (target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey, rollback command). Confirm the exact commit was independently verified. If there is no passing verification evidence, fail and recommend running Deploy to Development first. Read the project's saved Plan (Interfaces, Data, Documents) for the user journeys the smoke check must cover. Do not deploy, push, or change any runtime environment in this step, and never start Deploy to Development from this workflow.
steps.guardrail:
- Read-only: do not deploy, push, restart services, or edit project files
- Never infer deployment targets, commands, credentials, health checks, or rollback behavior
- Fail closed when verification evidence or deployment configuration is missing
failure_checklist: No passing verification evidence for an exact commit
Deployment target, command, health check or rollback is missing
The step changed a runtime environment
steps.validation_prompt: A release evidence packet names one exact verified commit and the maintained production target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey and rollback command; nothing was deployed.
steps.other_tool: Ticket result packet, repository state, maintained deployment configuration, saved Plan

steps.name: Production deployment approval
steps.instruction: Prepare a separate production promotion decision after development verification passes. Read the exact deployed commit and fresh development health and smoke evidence. Resolve the production target, deploy command, health check, critical production journey, and rollback command from maintained project configuration. Inspect the production working state without changing it and stop if there are unprotected production edits or target drift. Return a compact approval packet with the exact commit, files changed, test results, development evidence, production target, production deploy command, production health check, rollback command, and any production drift. This step must not deploy. Then stop and wait for Paul's explicit approval of this production deployment. This approval belongs to this workflow only; an approval given to any other run or workflow does not count.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not deploy in this step
- Preserve production-owned edits and stop on unexplained drift
- Never infer production commands, credentials, targets, health checks, or rollback behavior
failure_checklist: Development health or smoke evidence is absent or stale
Production target, deploy command, health check, critical journey, or rollback command is missing
Production drift or edits were ignored
A production runtime change occurred before approval
steps.validation_prompt: A separate production promotion approval packet exists for the development-verified commit, production state is protected, and no production deployment has occurred.

steps.name: Deploy approved commit to production
steps.instruction: Deploy only the exact commit approved in the production promotion decision to the configured production target. Recheck that the target and production state still match the approval packet, preserve production-owned content and edits, run the maintained deploy command, then execute the configured health check and critical production journey. Stop before mutation if approval delivery was not acknowledged or any target, commit, command, or drift evidence changed. On failed health or journey verification, execute the configured rollback command and verify the rollback. Never mark the ticket complete; move it to QA with deployment evidence so final completion remains a human action.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Execute only the exact separately approved production commit, target, and commands
- Preserve production-owned content and stop on drift
- Roll back on failed production health or journey verification
- Move the ticket to QA; only a human may mark QA complete
failure_checklist: Production deployment ran without the separate recorded approval
Deployed commit, target, or command differs from the approval packet
Production health check or critical journey is missing or failed
A failed production deployment was not rolled back and verified
The workflow marked QA complete without a human action
steps.validation_prompt: The separately approved commit is verified in production, rollback is verified for any failed attempt, and the ticket is in QA rather than Complete.

steps.name: Independently verify the production deployment
steps.instruction: From a fresh session, independently verify the production deployment: confirm the running commit equals the approved commit, run the configured health check and the critical production journey, and check for console or server errors. If any check fails, run the configured rollback command, verify the rollback, and fail this step with both pieces of evidence. Preserve production-owned content. Move the ticket to QA, never to Complete; final completion is a human action.
steps.guardrail:
- Verify only; do not redeploy or change code
- Roll back on failed health or journey verification
- Only a human may mark the ticket Complete
failure_checklist: Running commit differs from the approved commit
Health or journey check failed without rollback
steps.validation_prompt: Fresh production health and journey evidence for the approved commit, or verified rollback evidence on failure.

steps.name: Report the production deployment and compact memory
steps.instruction: Return a compact result packet for the ticket: the deployed commit, production deploy, health and journey evidence, rollback evidence if any, remaining risks and next actions. Do not mark the ticket Complete; it stays in QA for a human. This is a reporting transformation: do not re-run checks or edit project files. Write only durable memory deltas (deploy commands, targets, health checks, failures, lessons). Return the exact named fields ticket_result_packet, compact_memory_delta, failed_attempts, and lessons in the response.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not paste full transcripts into memory; compact durable facts only
- Ticket result must be usable by the next run without reading the full chat
- Do not re-run validation or inspect evidence; summarize the accepted upstream result
- Do not create or edit project files during reporting; return the packet in the model response only
failure_checklist: Changed files or commands are missing
Evidence or N/A reason is missing
Memory delta contains transcript noise instead of durable facts
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket contains summary, evidence, commands, changed files, risks/blockers, next actions, and compact memory deltas for future runs.
steps.other_tool: Ticket update, result packet, and compact workspace memory
